It is easier for members to make their folk delegates. The form is trivial and Jordan’s SLA for processing it is better than <insert-popular-storage-distribution-system>’s uptime.

And the benefit is we avoid any potential conflict over whether contributions are at odds with the member. And the individual gets greater access to resources like the reflector.
